breast.note: TAIL wiggle: spring chain on the bone tail. Level index = number of '.00' suffixes (root=0); stiff = stiff_root * stiff_tip_decay^level.

glute.note: HEAD wiggle (not tail): the glute bones are ~0.0026 units long and tail wiggle crashes Wiggle 2 with a singular matrix at that scale (see wiggle2_jiggle.py SCALE NOTE + vendored wiggle-2 USAGE.md gotcha #2).

face_guard.note: Bones matching these tokens are NEVER wiggle-configured or keyed (legacy rigs may still carry face bones; new rigs have none per the face standard). Verified by fcurve hash on every bake.

bake_path.note: The CURRENT production path: Wiggle 2 addon bakes spring motion into keyframes in Blender (tools/jiggle/wiggle2_jiggle.py). Used on rigs that already carry these Rigify deform chains (Scarlett/Star). Params below are the PROVEN bake values (CMU lambada clip, frames 1-72 @ 24 fps; proof: tools/jiggle/proof/scarlett-wiggle2-metrics.json). The driver (wiggle2_jiggle.py) reads bake_bone_patterns + bake_params from this table.

camel_toe.note: TORCH A3 REFERENCE PIECE ONLY — not in any default family set. Stays per-character by owner spec (Torch A3 is the jiggle reference piece: breasts, belly, hips/ass, thighs, camel-toe). Other characters get it only by explicit per-character spec.

note: Canonical WH jiggle standard (2026-10-22), wired from the DOA/SF/Tekken teardown research. ARCHITECTURE = SFV pattern: extra spring bones in the game skeleton + runtime spring integration (game/js/jiggle.js). Tekken is the negative example (no jiggle bones in its base skeleton). DOA's contribution = user-tunable intensity presets (Natural/DOA/OMG). Runtime spring params (0-1 scale) derive from the creation-suite jiggle-schema female family (mammary/belly/glutes/thighs stiffness+damping) — same owner-approved feel numbers, now driving real spring bones. Canonical bone names follow the Tekken/UE4 Left/Right-prefix convention already used by the 53-joint WH skeleton.

runtime.note: game/js/jiggle.js integrates these chains per frame: spring on each game bone, stiffness/damping/gravity_scale from runtime_params, scaled by the intensity preset.
